SELECT MIN(c.birth_date) AS earliest_birth, MAX(c.birth_date) AS latest_birth,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id) AS accounts_with_loans,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loans
FROM main.account AS a
JOIN main.disp AS d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN main.client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
LEFT JOIN main.loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'

WITH loans_per_account AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM main.account AS a
    LEFT JOIN main.loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.account_id IN (
        SELECT d.account_id
        FROM main.disp AS d
        JOIN main.client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
          AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
    )
    GROUP BY a.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS average_loans_per_account
FROM loans_per_account
LIMIT 1
